claims.claim: GAAP net income for fiscal Q3 2026 was $5.6 billion.
GAAP earnings per share for fiscal Q3 2026 were $2.97.
The GAAP net income and per-share figures each represented a 7% increase over the prior year.
claims.note: The bullet attaches a single '(7% increase over prior year)' to a combined net-income-and-EPS line. The release gives net income +7% but EPS +10%; as written the brief understates GAAP EPS growth.

claims.claim: Non-GAAP net income for fiscal Q3 2026 was $6.3 billion.
Non-GAAP earnings per share for fiscal Q3 2026 were $3.32.
The non-GAAP net income and per-share figures each represented an 8% increase over the prior year.
claims.note: The release gives non-GAAP net income +8% but non-GAAP EPS +11%. Attaching 8% to the per-share figure understates non-GAAP EPS growth.

claims.claim: Net revenue was $11.6 billion, up 14% year over year.
Net revenue increased 13% on a constant-dollar basis.
Payments volume increased 10% year over year.
Cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe increased 12% year over year.
Processed transactions increased 10% year over year.
Growth in payments volume, cross-border volume and processed transactions was strong.
That growth reflects resilient consumer and business spending.
Net revenue growth was driven by year-over-year growth in payments volume, cross-border volume and processed transactions.
The company did not provide any outlook or guidance for future periods.
Cash, cash equivalents and investment securities were $13.9 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Share repurchases and dividends were $6.2 billion for the quarter.
Cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe drives international transaction revenue, and it grew 12%.
Current-period results included special items such as severance costs and litigation provisions, which can affect net income and earnings per share.
